body: Symptom: visiting /apps/filemark/demo on the deployed website threw 'Error: useTheme must be used within ThemeProvider' caught by the TanStack router error boundary ('Something went wrong! [Show Error]'). Cause: even though the project rule is 'viewers use useThemeOptional, never useTheme' (lore decision dec_019e403b…), at least one component reachable from MDXViewer's render tree still calls strict useTheme (probably a non-viewer helper component — needs grep). Fix in the consumer: ALWAYS wrap <MDXViewer> in <ThemeProvider> from @filemark/core, the same pattern chrome-ext + apps/desktop use. Long-term: audit components imported by MDXViewer for useTheme→useThemeOptional candidates so standalone embedding actually works as advertised. Caught visually via headless Electron offscreen + console-message handler — file://-only build hides this because the wrapper sites all happen to provide ThemeProvider.
title: @filemark/mdx requires <ThemeProvider> wrapper — uses strict useTheme internally
